name: Asuhara Yuuko
source:
After graduating from a prestigious private university with excellent grades, she became a Japanese language teacher at an elite private school in the city. However, she was stalked by a janitor who worked at the school, and due to the psychological stress, she requested a transfer and moved to a school in a rural area.

Thanks to her natural cheerfulness and sincere approach to the students, she quickly became a popular figure at the school. Additionally, many male students secretly admire and admire her for her beauty.

She is occasionally approached for love advice from female students, but since she has little experience with men, she can only offer general advice based on knowledge rather than personal experience. As a result, she relies on information from magazines and friends to stay informed.

She is a teacher who is always smiling and always has a kind word for everyone.

[from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11746]official site[/url]]
